label: Installed apps list
purpose: Records the list of apps installed on this PC each day while its owner is signed in, so a rebuilt machine can reinstall them in one step.

label: Client site archive
purpose: Copies a client site's newest nightly snapshot into a private archive each week.

label: Page taps applied
purpose: Applies the taps I make on the Command Center page to my own notes, so a close or snooze on the phone lands in the one record of them.

label: Phone check
purpose: Checks that the PC can still reach my phone, re-arms the link after the phone restarts, and reports what it found to the Command Center page.

label: Status page refresh
purpose: Every half hour, gathers what is waiting on me, what it cost, what is broken and what moved, and sends it to my phone page.

label: Encrypted backup
purpose: Takes an encrypted backup of a private store, so losing this PC does not lose it.

label: Drive scrub
purpose: Reads every file stored on the PC’s drive once a month, so a damaged spot is found while the rest of the file can still be saved.

label: Sign-in leak fix
purpose: At each sign-in, switches off an operating-system setting that measurement showed leaking memory while agents ran.

label: Private site backup
purpose: Copies a private site's database and stored files into a backup on this PC each night.

label: Weekly career draft
purpose: Drafts the week's additions to a private career record from saved work sessions; nothing is added until it is approved.

label: Morning check reminder
purpose: Reopens the morning site check's window at each unlock and every two hours through the day while a question waits, with one phone line at noon.

label: Site check
purpose: Compares this site’s systems pages with this PC each morning and opens a window to publish any change with one click.

label: Machine watch
purpose: Reads this PC’s health (disk, memory, hangs) and reports anything wrong at the start of the next session, because a machine that is merely unusable logs almost nothing.

label: Overnight chain
purpose: Runs the night’s maintenance one job after another so no two collide: the slow test tier of every project, the rebuild of the two reference sites, the reading of the AI tools’ changed documentation, the status page’s nightly refresh, a sweep for stray processes and leftover development servers, and last the backup that commits and pushes every project and walks the restore runbook. The morning review opens only once the night has finished.

label: Runtime updates
purpose: Checks each week for a newer release of the language runtime the projects here run on. A bug-fix release is checked against its published fingerprints and installed. Each project’s pinned version moves to match only when every check on that project passes, and a new major release is tested on fresh copies and put to me rather than installed.

label: Desktop layout audit
purpose: Backs up and audits the taskbar layout, and speaks up only when something is wrong.

label: Agent wake
purpose: Wakes the agent when a scheduled job, a task or a standing goal is waiting for it, and costs nothing when none is.

label: Daily failure check
purpose: Checks the agent’s last day for a failed run, an undelivered message, a stopped service or a silent watchdog, and messages me only when it finds one. Every completed check is recorded, so a quiet day can be told apart from a check that stopped running.

label: Alerting heartbeat
purpose: Pings me every week whether or not anything broke, so a dead alert channel shows up as a missing ping instead of a missed outage.

label: Weekly agent report
purpose: Sends me the agent’s week in one message: a short briefing on the week’s AI news for people who run plants and supply chains, the work it finished and published, choices it made alone for me to reverse, its spend against the monthly limit, and anything that failed. Its open questions arrive as buttons to tap, and one left unanswered for two weeks takes the default it stated.

label: Workload export
purpose: Exports the agent’s workload numbers into its own repo, where the board reads them.

label: Domain request broker
purpose: Checks the agent’s requests to reach new web domains and escalates each one to me for a decision.

label: Agent tooling update
purpose: Stages each new release of the agent’s own tooling, tests it, and switches it over only when it passes.

label: Poller watchdog
purpose: Restarts the agent’s chat poller if it stalls.

label: Proxy log rotation
purpose: Rotates the logs of the proxy that all of the agent’s outbound traffic goes through.

label: Tunnel self-update
purpose: Upgrades the status page server's secure tunnel each night and alerts the phone if the upgrade fails.

label: Phone alert watch
purpose: Every five minutes, looks for a new red fault, a new question from an agent or something coming back today, and sends one notification for each; quiet overnight except for red faults.

label: Agents status fetch
purpose: Fetches both agents’ own status files so the phone page shows their questions, spend and faults beside everything else.

label: Repos and job board refresh
purpose: Refreshes this site’s public repos list every day, and pulls and scores the job board every morning; gates both for anything private, and commits only what changed.

label: Podcast sync
purpose: Publishes any new podcast episode to this site after checking its audio and provenance.

label: Librarian
purpose: Librarian — nightly curation pass

label: Vault sync
purpose: Vault sync (commit brain writes, converge with GitHub)

label: MCP reaper
purpose: Reap leaked MCP filesystem children by restarting the remote connectors

label: Firewall audit
purpose: Firewall audit — nightly tripwire over the synced (Open + Private) tiers

label: Watchdog
purpose: Watchdog — 10-min staleness sentinel (silent-failure detector)

label: Pipeline canary
purpose: Pipeline canary — daily end-to-end filing proof (drop -> model -> note -> ledger)

label: Alert heartbeat
purpose: Weekly alerting heartbeat — a dead alert channel becomes noticeable by ABSENCE

label: Skills refresh
purpose: Skills refresh (mirror the canonical skills library into the vault tree)

label: Graph audit
purpose: Graph-health audit — nightly read-only tripwire over the Open knowledge graph (#9)

label: Auto-refresh
purpose: Regenerate the architecture view from the latest repo (self-refresh)
